Handle your business.

Clear three blocks in each neighborhood, then take down the boss. Follow the GO arrow when the street is clear. Finish all three neighborhoods to settle the score.

Gamepads: left stick / D-pad move · X hit · B kick · A jump · Y special · LB block · Start pause. First pad controls P1, second pad P2.

Stay in their lane. Line up vertically before attacking. Jump kicks hit harder. Chain hits to build a combo and refill your special meter. Block facing the attacker. Pick up sandwiches for health and envelopes for points.

Carmela: vacuum strikes + “Some Pulp” phone throw.
Tony: heavy punches + a charging shoulder.
Artie: skillet swings + a flying pan.
Junior: long-reach cane + a spinning cane sweep.
